component.name: tappaas-cicd
component.description: TAPPaaS module tappaas-cicd: generated from tappaas-cicd-components.json; do not edit.

analysis.detail: tappaas-cicd/nix:libssh. Channel callbacks after close in an SSH session; libssh is only ansible-pylibssh's, and ansible-core is used for module-spec validation, never to connect. Decided by migration 2026-11-12; review by 2027-05-11.

tappaas-cicd/nix:libxslt. XSLT key() processing; libxslt is only lxml's, pulled in by ansible-core's validation-only dependencies, and no TAPPaaS code runs XSLT. Decided by migration 2026-11-12; review by 2027-05-11.
